title: AI for Materials
description: Machine learning for molecular and materials modeling, with an interest in the relationships between structure, dynamics, and macroscopic properties.

title: Molecular Dynamics & Machine Learning Potentials
description: Learned interatomic interactions for molecular simulation, with interests in the application and computational efficiency of machine learning potentials.

title: HPC Optimization of ML Interatomic Potentials
description: My interest in MLIP efficiency grew out of GPU-memory limitations encountered while developing UMA / FAIR-Chem polymer-simulation workflows. I want to understand where these models spend memory and computation, and how to improve simulation throughput while preserving physical predictions. My MACE resource pilot is an initial measurement study; a new optimization method remains a research goal.

title: Coarse-Grained Molecular Modeling
description: Reduced molecular descriptions that connect atomistic detail with modeling at larger length and time scales, and the information those descriptions retain about molecular dynamics.

title: Representation Learning / JEPA
description: I study learned molecular representations and physically useful prediction, from completed CG and MACE-water JEPA explorations to pretrained-feature transfer and label efficiency. Controlled synthetic-response tests help separate state information, temporal propagation, and physical readout.

title: Polymer Property Prediction
description: Molecular simulation and machine learning for polymer properties, including density and glass-transition temperature. Current workflow development connects classical preparation, MACE sampling, and carefully matched references; interest in agentic polymer workflows remains part of this direction.
